input.subject: Mathematics
input.lessonContent: Fractions name parts of a whole. In 3/4, the 4 is the denominator and shows how many equal parts the whole is cut into; the 3 is the numerator and shows how many parts we take. To add fractions with the same denominator, add the numerators and keep the denominator: 1/5 + 2/5 = 3/5. To add fractions with different denominators, first change them to equivalent fractions with a common denominator: 1/2 + 1/3 = 3/6 + 2/6 = 5/6.
